title: Kanban drag-and-drop announces raw record ids to screen readers ("Draggable item gZguOoFVfxm_pSPG was moved over droppable area 4iDmJaZr0O0St1fb") — the board's DndContext carries no announcements, unlike the form designer's (objectui#11802)
body:
**Filing gate ①**: a user-visible accessibility defect with a named landing and a live reproduction. A screen-reader user hears database ids where the card title and the column label exist.

QA-source: objectstack-ai/objectstack#23953 · ux-conventions.labels-over-machine-names · observation (ux runner; re-checked and filed under objectstack-ai/objectstack#23878)

## What happens

The kanban board's `DndContext` is given no `accessibility.announcements`, so dnd-kit's built-in English sentences are spoken through its live region. Those sentences name the draggable and the droppable by their ids. Card ids are record ids (`id: item.id || item._id`) and column ids are option values. The form designer had exactly this bug and fixed it with custom announcements (objectui#11802, `formDndAnnouncements.ts`). The board never got the same treatment.

## Reach — measured, 2/2 fresh loads

Environment: objectstack `7277c07f` (main, 2026-10-16), `examples/app-showcase` booted from a main worktree: `OS_PORT=47321 objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin -p 47321 -d file:…/data.db`, with a fresh DB. Console: objectui `daeb77fc` (the `.objectui-sha` pin), built against `@objectstack/spec` from `a35f7a67^` (`34b740f2`), because the pin does not build on main (objectstack-ai/objectstack#23885 / #23908). `check:console-sha` matches. Playwright with `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`, form sign-in as the seeded admin, and a screenshot taken before every DOM read. Code path re-read on objectui main `023087f63`, where it is still present.

1. Open `/_console/apps/com.example.showcase/showcase_task/view/showcase_task.board` (Board (Kanban)).
2. Press the mouse on the first card "Content backlog" (`[aria-roledescription="sortable"]`) and move it about 330 px right, over the next column's cards.
3. Read `#DndLiveRegion-0`:
   - on pick-up: `Draggable item gZguOoFVfxm_pSPG was moved over droppable area gZguOoFVfxm_pSPG.`
   - over the target: `Draggable item gZguOoFVfxm_pSPG was moved over droppable area 4iDmJaZr0O0St1fb.` (`4iDmJaZr0O0St1fb` is the record id of "SEO migration plan")
   - Escape: `Dragging was cancelled. Draggable item gZguOoFVfxm_pSPG was dropped.`

The drag was cancelled, so nothing was written.

- **Expected:** the announcements name the card by its title and the target by the column label (or the neighbouring card's title), for example "Picked up Content backlog. … over To Do".
- **Actual:** raw ids.

## Where (objectui main `023087f63`)

- `packages/plugin-kanban/src/KanbanImpl.tsx:1165-1170`: `<DndContext sensors collisionDetection onDragStart onDragEnd>`, with no `accessibility` prop.
- `KanbanImpl.tsx:217`: `useSortable({ id: card.id, … })`. `:627-628`: `useSortable({ id: column.id, data: { type: "column" } })`.
- `packages/plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.tsx:1418`: `id: item.id || item._id`. Column ids stay the option `val`, and only `title` is localized (around `:1441-1460`).
- The fix pattern in-repo: `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/formDndAnnouncements.ts`, passed as `accessibility={dndAccessibility}` at `ObjectFormDesigner.tsx:847` (objectui#11802).

## Done when

- The board passes `accessibility.announcements` (localized through the console catalogue) that resolve the active and over ids to the card title and the column label. A test pins that the live-region strings carry the title and label and none of the ids.

**Reader who acts:** the `domain:ui` execution seat (plugin-kanban). No spec contract change is needed: the generic block is dnd-kit's `Announcements`, as already used by the form designer.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectui, all states: "kanban drag and drop screen reader announcement raw record id column id" → 3 hits, all read. #11802 (closed) is the form-designer instance of this class. #12619 and #8428 are unrelated. None covers the kanban board.

Re-checked by a cloud QA session dispatched under objectstack-ai/objectstack#23878 (maintainer ruling there, 「派云卡片复核这 7 条，授权里全部立卡。有时间间隔就行」).
